job.title: Enterprise Automation Engineer
job.pay_full: $150,000 – $191,000 a year (estimated yearly salary), plus equity; may include variable compensation

details.about: Datadog's Enterprise Automation Engineering team drives efficiency across the company through systems automation and integrations, AI agents and MCP development, working with People, Finance, GTM, Legal, Recruiting and Technical Solutions teams. In this senior-level role you design and build the integrations, automations, agents and internal apps behind Datadog's internal systems, working with business systems analysts and stakeholders, and help shape how agentic tooling is used in internal workflows. Datadog operates as a hybrid workplace.
duties: Architect, build and maintain production-grade integrations, automations, agents and internal apps across systems such as Workday, Greenhouse, NetSuite and Salesforce
Lead technical design: data flows, error handling, scalability and architecture for multi-system workflows
Design and develop agentic workflows, MCP servers and LLM-integrated solutions
Define production-ready standards for internal systems: governance, observability, reliability and maintainability
Advise on build vs. buy for tools and platforms
Work with Security, Privacy and Compliance to meet standards such as GDPR, SOX, SOC 2 and FedRAMP
needs: Demonstrated experience building and shipping with AI/agentic tools (an LLM, an agent framework or an MCP)
Strong judgment on build vs. buy and custom vs. configuration
Able to explain technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Experience working autonomously on a small, high-ownership team at a high-growth company
5+ years administering and integrating business systems (e.g. NetSuite, Zendesk, Salesforce or Workday) or a similar role
4+ years leading medium to large cross-functional projects across Finance, HR and Sales
3+ years designing and building multi-system integrations with middleware (e.g. Workato, Boomi, Mulesoft, Zapier)
In-depth knowledge of SQL and object-oriented programming (e.g. Python, Java)
details.benefits: Estimated yearly salary $150,000 – $191,000, plus a competitive equity package; compensation may include variable pay. Benefits include healthcare, dental, parental planning and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, new-hire stock equity (RSUs) and a discounted employee stock purchase plan, plus professional development, training and a mentor and buddy program.
notes: Datadog encourages people to apply even if they don't meet every qualification on day one
